parameters.query: SELECT s.* FROM scripts s WHERE s.status = 'approved' AND s.media_file IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.platform = 'tiktok' AND p.status IN ('submitted','published') AND p.posted_at > now() - interval '1 day') < 4 ORDER BY s.id LIMIT 1;
SELECT platform, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, extra FROM tokens;
UPDATE scripts SET status = 'posted', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

parameters.query: UPDATE posts SET status = 'published', error = NULL WHERE script_id = $1 AND platform = 'instagram';
UPDATE posts SET status = 'failed', error = 'IG transcode timeout - publish manual dari app' WHERE script_id = $1 AND platform = 'instagram' AND status = 'submitted';
SELECT platform, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, extra FROM tokens;
UPDATE tokens SET access_token = $1, refresh_token = CASE WHEN $2 = '' THEN refresh_token ELSE $2 END, expires_at = $3, updated_at = now() WHERE platform = $4;
